title: Bengaluru: Bangladeshi women lured with jobs via TikTok and Facebook ("TikTok Ridoy")
summary: In May 2021 a video of the gang rape of a 22-year-old Bangladeshi woman in Bengaluru went viral. Police arrested 12 people, 11 of them Bangladeshi nationals who had entered India illegally, and said the ring lured young Bangladeshi women with the pretext of employment, in some cases telling them the destination was Dubai, then forced them into prostitution; the victim was assaulted for refusing sex work. The ringleader, Rifadul Islam alias "TikTok Ridoy", used a TikTok following and Facebook groups to recruit. On 20 and 21 May 2022 a special court in Bengaluru convicted eleven: seven men were sentenced to life imprisonment, one woman to 20 years, one man to five years and two women to nine months under the Foreigners Act.
